column_description: A BIGSERIAL primary key for session records (e.g., 401).
A BIGINT FK referencing Users(UserKey) to link the session to a user.
A BIGINT FK referencing Devices(DevKey) to link the session to a device.
A TIMESTAMP indicating when the session started (e.g., '2025-03-12 14:00:00').
An INT capturing the session's total duration in seconds (e.g., 1200 = 20 minutes).
An INT counting how many pages/articles the user viewed in this session (e.g., 5).
A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring the bounce rate for the session (e.g., 25.00).
An INT measuring how deep the user navigated (e.g., 3 screens).
A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring session engagement (e.g., 70.00).
An INT indicating how many recommendations were shown to the user (e.g., 10).
An INT counting how many recommendation clicks occurred (e.g., 2).
A NUMERIC(5,2) capturing the click-through rate for recommendations (e.g., 20.00).
An enum (languagecode_enum) describing the user's language (fr, es, en, de, zh).
An enum (timezoneoffset_enum) for the user’s time zone offset (8, 1, 0, -5, -8).
An INET column storing the user's IP address (e.g., '192.168.0.10').
A VARCHAR(100) referencing the user’s country based on IP geo (e.g., 'USA').
A VARCHAR(100) referencing the user’s region or state (e.g., 'California').
A VARCHAR(100) referencing the user’s city (e.g., 'San Francisco').
A VARCHAR(30) referencing an experiment ID or tag (e.g., 'EXP123').
An enum (personalizationversion_enum) for personalization system version (v4, v1, v3, v2, v5).
A VARCHAR(50) referencing a recommendation set ID if used (e.g., 'RecSetXYZ').
A NUMERIC(5,2) capturing overall content relevance (e.g., 75.50).
A NUMERIC(5,2) referencing personalization accuracy (e.g., 80.00).
A NUMERIC(5,2) measuring recommendation utility or value (e.g., 70.25).
